comment: She was a really great professor.  Speaks very clearly and moves the class at a good pace.  A lot of homework and assessments (test, quizzes, short papers) but your Spanish will definitely improve.  Most of the homework is straight out of the textbook and not very difficult.  She is very nice and really cares about her students.

Buchanan convinced me to become a spanish minor. She tries to bring you into the culture just as much as teaching you the grammar. Great teacher for the spanish requirement because you learn a lot and she's not that hard. If you are considering minoring, take 221 with her

I thought this was a really good class. It was a bunch of stuff to due (the compositions, quizzes, and always at least medium amounts of homework) but the work wasn't that difficult. She is in general a good teacher, she knows how to teach.

If you enjoy workbook activities and high school Spanish classes, you'll enjoy her. I found her completely uninspiring and I barely improved my Spanish. She grades easily on tests but very hard on compositions (ex: C's for 5 grammar mistakes) but you can rewrite. HW isn't bad but half of the class days there's either a comp. due, a quiz, or a test.

She is a very nice teacher and speaks Spanish very clearly for those who are only proficient in the language. It is rather high schoolish in difficulty, so if you're looking for a pretty easy spanish class, this is for you, but if you really want to learn and improve your spanish more significantly take LAIS 305 with Ricardo.
Spanish and Business is the best class ever!  She is super sweet, the material is crystal clear, and tests arent too hard.  Pretty easy grader, flexible, not a ton of work.

Very nice woman. Sometimes can come off to be ruthless, but if you get on her good side (which isn't that hard) then life is good. Medium hard grader, but if you work hard and do your daily homework you'll get a good grade.
Buchanan is a great professor. She makes spanish fun and easy to learn. I loved her and if she wasn't retiring...again...I would encourage you to take her class.
Class was like a high school one with more work

Really talented lady and the best abuela ever. She is so nice and well-versed prof. She should be teaching higher level classes. If you want to learn grammar and Spanish you take her. I learned so much. She is also a wonderful person. SO much talented, look out for her class, they are perfect!
Senora Buchanan is worth taking if given the opportunity.  She allows revisions on all written works and tests aren't too hard
great teacher. Shes easy to get off task (talk about current events in spain!) but you definitely learn and she will give you help if you need it!
